plainText:
The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the ninth season of , Pokémon: Battle Frontier, in and ( ).

==Boxed sets==
Two Pokémon: Battle Frontier DVD box sets were released by VIZ Media in 2008, containing the whole season between them. There are two boxed sets each containing three DVD cases with one disc each. Optional English closed captioning is included on the DVDs.

===Volume 1: Episodes 1-24===
 
Pokémon: Battle Frontier - Volume 1 was released by VIZ Media on June 24, 2008. It contains three discs with 24 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is DPMBBS01.

 

===Volume 2: Episodes 25-47===
 
Pokémon: Battle Frontier - Volume 2 was released by VIZ Media on September 16, 2008. It contains three discs with 23 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is DPMBBS02.

 

==The Complete Collection==
 
Pokémon: Battle Frontier - The Complete Collection was released on January 8, 2019 by VIZ Media and distributed through . This Complete Collection contains six discs with all 47 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is 3000079693. This release consists of a single DVD case in a slip cover.

 

==External links==
